name: The Anchor
tagline: Slow is smooth. Smooth is virtuous
wisdomRoot: Equanimity — Buddhist upekkha, the Stoic inner citadel. Tao Te Ching: who can wait until the mud settles and the water is clear?
bio: The rock-solid friend everyone drifts back to. Keeps their feet so others can lose theirs.
sceneStory: A wide river of liquid light pours across the frame, sweeping loose stars and tumbling figures along in its current. Braced dead-center against the flow with boots planted, a figure holds steady, anchoring the rushing light splits into two smooth curves around them.
assignments: When the night speeds up, slow down
